headline: Sensex Ends Marginally Lower While Nifty Holds Above 23,250 Level
why: Rebound in US tech stocks and easing oil prices provided global support
Domestic realty and pharma sectors saw gains exceeding 1.5 percent
Concerns over US mortgage rates and potential Fed rate hikes weighed
whatHappening: Premium two-wheeler segment grew by 22 percent according to TVS Motor
Legal dispute emerges over N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman
Coforge reports record deal pipeline and remains confident in growth outlook
India prioritizes energy security amidst discussions on US sanctions bill

stocksInNews.sources: Premium motorcycle segment growth of 22 percent
Record deal pipeline and confident growth outlook
Focus on opening trade and regulatory environment
Legal dispute over Tata Sons chairman reappointment

summary: The Indian market shows resilience with Nifty holding 23,250 despite global volatility and domestic corporate governance disputes. Investors are monitoring US Fed policies and sector-specific growth in premium manufacturing and IT.
